responsibility: This header is the main public interface to the optabs expansion subsystem. It defines expand_operand and operand-construction helpers, optab fallback policies, and declarations for arithmetic, comparison, conversion, vector, atomic, and insn-legitimization routines, allowing expression and statement expanders to query target capabilities and emit operations through a uniform instruction-or-libcall abstraction.
same_name_distinction: Provides the public C++ interface for the optabs stem, defining expand_operand and declaring expansion, comparison, atomic, and instruction-generation helpers used by other GCC code. Unlike gcc/optabs.cc, it does not implement expansion, and unlike gcc/optabs.def, it is a hand-written API header rather than the optab definition list.
